description: Barnes-Hut N-body simulation using 2D quadtree. Tree built on CPU, flattened for GPU. GPU computes forces by tree traversal and integrates positions/velocities.

scaling_param.name: bodies
scaling_param.description: Number of bodies in the simulation

non_scaling_params.name: theta
non_scaling_params.description: Barnes-Hut opening angle (controls accuracy vs speed tradeoff)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run the optional clock/cache warmer after initial CPU tree construction and uploads, immediately before the first force kernel. No warmer between kernels or later timesteps; subsequent hybrid-stage state requires target qualification.
